name: Ariden's Camp
summary: In Deadwind Pass, Ariden's Camp lies abandoned north of the road from Duskwood to the Swamp of Sorrows. Travelers pass beneath Karazhan's shadow and wonder who pitched a tent there.

sections.title: A Silent Encampment
sections.body:
North of the road from Duskwood to the Swamp of Sorrows, weathered cloth and cold ashes mark Ariden's Camp. It may once have been an ordinary stop, long abandoned by living men.

Dark sorcery has left its mark across Deadwind Pass. No one knows who named the camp for Ariden or what fortune its owner sought near Karazhan. The pass's lingering horrors have swallowed the answer.

faq.answer: Ariden's Camp lies in Deadwind Pass, just north of the main road from Duskwood in the west to the Swamp of Sorrows in the east. It is not far from Karazhan.

faq.q: Are there any active threats at the camp right now?
faq.answer: The camp's clearing is quiet and still. Deadwind ogres, spectral apparitions, and foul winged beasts that roost near Karazhan prowl the pass around it.

angles.text: As a mage, you may find the deserted camp unsettling so near Karazhan. Few who linger near Medivh's tower stay long.
As a rogue, you can see that someone made camp beneath a terrifying spire and never returned for their things. The choice seems either ambitious or foolish.
